canonical.title: A weekend in Baudour, anchored on dinner at d'Eugénie à Émilie

siblings.title: Day-trips and activities within 30 km of d'Eugénie à Émilie
siblings.summary: Pairi Daiza for a full day, Mons in a half-day, Grand-Hornu next door — what to drive to around Baudour, ranked by distance and pay-off.

siblings.title: Walking-distance lodging at or near d'Eugénie à Émilie
siblings.summary: Triple E — the Fernez family's three-room boutique inn directly across the square — is the only real walk-home bed; everything else is a 3 km+ taxi.

siblings.title: Special-character lodging within taxi range of d'Eugénie à Émilie
siblings.summary: Eight character properties near the 2-star d'Eugénie à Émilie — from an 18th-c Spanish farm in the same commune to a converted neo-Gothic chapel in Mons and underwater rooms at Pairi Daiza.

siblings.title: IT conferences and tech events within 30 km of d'Eugénie à Émilie
siblings.summary: The 30 km bubble around Baudour is anchored on Mons — Le CLICK and the Initialis science park host the flagships (DevDay 3 Dec, DevFest 27 Nov, Forum Innovation & Cloud); Valenciennes's Serre Numérique grazes the edge.

sources.title: Triple E Hotel — Baudour
sources.claim: Three rooms across from d'Eugénie à Émilie — Eugénie €190, Émilie €210, Éric €190; breakfast €30/person 8:00–10:30.

sources.title: d'Eugénie à Émilie — Réservations
sources.claim: Place de la Résistance 1, 7331 Baudour; single seating 19:00–19:45; affiliated Triple E hotel; phone 065/61.31.70.

sources.title: Michelin Guide — d'Eugénie à Émilie
sources.claim: Two Michelin stars; chef Éric Fernez with daughter Émilie front-of-house.

sources.title: DH — Fernez reopens after renovation
sources.claim: Reopened end-Feb 2026 after a full dining-room and kitchen overhaul; booked solid every service.

sources.title: DH — Le Faitout fire (Jan 2026)
sources.claim: Le Faitout, the Fernez bistro on the same square, suffered a small fire in January 2026 and closed temporarily.

sources.title: L'Avenir — Michelin 2026 Wallonia
sources.claim: d'Eugénie à Émilie retains its two stars in the 2026 guide.

sources.title: Gault & Millau — d'Eugénie à Émilie
sources.claim: 17.5/20 Gault & Millau; reopening expected end of February 2026.

sources.title: VisitMons — d'Eugénie à Émilie
sources.claim: Address Place de la Résistance 1, 7331 Baudour.

sources.title: Triple E — Contact
sources.claim: Avenue Louis Goblet 152, 7331 Saint-Ghislain (Baudour); limited parking on request.

sources.title: OpenAlfa — Avenue Louis Goblet
sources.claim: Avenue Louis Goblet is a 0.37 km street that intersects Place de Baudour — minutes' walk from Place de la Résistance.

sources.title: Tripadvisor — Baudour hotels
sources.claim: No hotel properties physically in Baudour; the nearest indexed options are all in adjacent communes 1.7–3.5 km away.

sources.title: Ferme de la Blanche Fontaine — Ghlin
sources.claim: 3-room rural B&B in Ghlin (~3.7 km), 9.1/10 on Booking; Ton & Ingrid Van Leeuwen.

sources.title: Tripadvisor — Cense de Lalouette
sources.claim: 18th-c coaching inn, 3 apart-hotel units, 4.5/5 on Tripadvisor, $136–$233/night; ~3.4 km from Baudour.

sources.title: VisitMons — Cense de Lalouette
sources.claim: 18th-c Spanish post-relay farm fully renovated in Saint-Ghislain.

sources.title: Cense de Lalouette — address
sources.claim: 188 Rue de Tournai, 7333 Saint-Ghislain (Tertre).

sources.title: Tripadvisor — MAH Hotel
sources.claim: 3-star, 55-room hotel ~3.5 km from the restaurant; mixed reviews.

sources.title: Booking — La Marelle Blaregnies
sources.claim: Fernez sister property: 5 rooms + Bib Gourmand bistro; ~22 km south of Baudour.

sources.title: VisitWallonia — Martin's Dream Hotel
sources.claim: Built within the walls of a former neo-Gothic chapel/convent of the Sisters of Belian Abbey in Mons centre.

sources.title: Martin's Dream Hotel
sources.claim: 62 themed rooms (Belgian flavours, Carnival of Binche, the five continents); Cinq Mondes spa.

sources.title: Mons Dragon House
sources.claim: 5 themed rooms (Belfry, Golden Chariot, Doudou, Dragon, Canonesses) each designed by a local Mons designer.

sources.title: VisitMons — Hôtel Saint-James
sources.claim: 21 rooms around an inner courtyard in an 18th-c residence; <10 min walk from Mons Grand-Place.

sources.title: Tripadvisor — Hôtel Infotel
sources.claim: 18th-c mansion 60 m south of Mons Grand-Place; mixed reviews on cleanliness/ageing rooms.

sources.title: Tripadvisor — L'Écureuil Frameries
sources.claim: 2-room guesthouse, #1 specialty lodging in Frameries; 400 m from SPARK'OH.

sources.title: Gîtes de Wallonie — Les Peupliers
sources.claim: 3-room B&B in a renovated farmhouse in Erbisœul (Jurbise), 8 km from Mons; heated outdoor pool May–Sept; sauna.

sources.title: Pairi Daiza Resort
sources.claim: 209 themed lodges; new Edenya wing 2026 adds 88 units incl. underwater rooms; park access bookended around stay.

sources.title: Pairi Daiza — Walrus House
sources.claim: 6 rooms each offering an underwater view into the walrus habitat.

sources.title: Pairi Daiza press — 4k bookings
sources.claim: 3,976 stays booked in 24 hours for the 2026 season; Saturday/Sunday underwater rooms sell out fastest.

sources.title: Tripadvisor — Pairi Daiza Resort
sources.claim: Some guests warn that views fail to deliver — one €800 polar-bear room showed a pump rather than a bear.

sources.title: Pairi Daiza — day-ticket pricing
sources.claim: 2026 adult online €43–€52; child (3–11) €37–€46; senior €41–€50; under-3s free; ticket office +€5.

sources.title: Pairi Daiza — opening hours
sources.claim: 2026 season runs 7 February 2026 – 31 January 2027; calendar tiers €25/€43/€49/€52.

sources.title: Wikipedia — Pairi Daiza
sources.claim: 75 ha on former Cambron Abbey grounds in Brugelette; 7,000+ animals; opened 1993 as Paradisio.

sources.title: Pairi Daiza — discover
sources.claim: 7,500 animals across 800 species in nine themed worlds; Michelin Green Guide three-star; 'Best Zoo in Europe'.

sources.title: Belga News — Edenya opens
sources.claim: Edenya opened 7 Feb 2026; Guinness-recognised world's largest tropical greenhouse — 4 ha, 24 m glass roof, 17 m waterfall.

sources.title: VisitWallonia — Pairi Daiza access
sources.claim: Park 1.2 km from Cambron-Casteau station (Mons–Ath line); motorway A8/E429 exit 26 or 30.

sources.title: VisitMons — Belfry of Mons
sources.claim: Tue–Sun 10:00–18:00; €7–10; UNESCO 1999; only baroque belfry in Belgium.

sources.title: UNESCO — Belfries of Belgium and France
sources.claim: 32 Belgian belfries listed 1999; extended 2005 to include 23 French belfries plus Gembloux.

sources.title: Wikipedia — Ducasse de Mons
sources.claim: Doudou falls on Trinity Sunday — 31 May 2026; Car d'Or descent 30 May; UNESCO Masterpiece.

sources.title: Musée du Doudou
sources.claim: Grand-Place 1625 red-brick building; Tue–Sun 10–18; €9/€6; closed Mondays.

sources.title: VisitMons — Maison Van Gogh
sources.claim: Cuesmes — where Vincent lived Dec 1878–Oct 1880; Tue–Sun 10–16; €2–4; free under 12.

sources.title: Mundaneum — visits FAQ
sources.claim: Wed–Fri 10–17, Sat–Sun 10–18; closed Mon/Tue; €2–9; free 1st Sunday.

sources.title: Tripadvisor — Mundaneum
sources.claim: Archive-museum of Paul Otlet's pre-internet card-index utopia; 3 floors, multi-lingual videos; free first Sunday.

sources.title: VisitMons — Mons Memorial Museum
sources.claim: Restored 1871 Machine à Eau; WWI/WWII history; Tue–Sun 10–18; €7 adult, €3 child.

sources.title: Collégiale Sainte-Waudru — hours
sources.claim: Free Brabantine Gothic collegiate church Mon–Sat 9–18, Sun 9:30–18; Treasury €5/€4 Tue–Sun 12–18.

sources.title: Anciens Abattoirs — Mons
sources.claim: 19th-c former slaughterhouse on Rue de la Trouille; contemporary visual arts & BeCraft; Tue–Sun 12–18 during shows.

sources.title: VisitWallonia — BAM Mons
sources.claim: BAM reopened 2024 as part of the new CAP cluster (Culture, Art et Patrimoine); Tue–Sun 10–18.

sources.title: MAC's — Grand-Hornu
sources.claim: Reopens 14 Jun 2026 with Lucia Bru, 'Ravi de te connaître', 'Le Regard éloigné'.

sources.title: MAC's — hours and prices
sources.claim: Tue–Sun 10–18; €10 / €6 reduced; free under 6 and 1st Sunday; same-day train ticket = free site access.

sources.title: Grand-Hornu — site
sources.claim: Neoclassical former colliery built 1810–1830 by Henri De Gorge; 10,000 m² across 3.5-ha park; UNESCO.

sources.title: UNESCO — Major Mining Sites of Wallonia
sources.claim: Grand-Hornu, Bois-du-Luc, Bois du Cazier, Blegny-Mine inscribed 2012 — a 170 km strip.

sources.title: TL Magazine — Memo at CID Grand-Hornu
sources.claim: 'Memo. Remembering the Futures' at CID 29 Mar – 30 Aug 2026.

sources.title: Canal du Centre — cruises
sources.claim: Cruises Wed–Sun, 10:00 & 14:00, Apr–Oct; 2h30; €18/€15/€12; locks, lifts, machine-room.

sources.title: VisitWallonia — Strépy-Thieu lift
sources.claim: Funicular boat-lift interpretation centre with machine room, panorama, scale models, construction film.

sources.title: UNESCO — Canal du Centre boat lifts
sources.claim: Inscribed 1998; English engineer Edwin Clark; only hydraulic boat lifts still working in original 19th-c condition.

sources.title: SPARK'OH! — tickets
sources.claim: Frameries science park; €25/€20/€20; school holidays 10–18 daily.

sources.title: VisitWallonia — SPARK'OH!
sources.claim: 12,000 m² themed indoor + 6,000 m² outdoor; 4D cinema, adventure course, biodiversity garden.

sources.title: Brasserie Saint-Feuillien — tours
sources.claim: Le Roeulx; Saturdays 14:00/14:30; €12 adult incl. 2-beer tasting; closed 23 Feb – 16 Mar 2026.

sources.title: Brasserie de l'Abbaye des Rocs
sources.claim: Montignies-sur-Roc; Sunday tours from 11:00 at €5/person; well water, no flavourings.

sources.title: DevDay 2026
sources.claim: Largest Wallonia dev conference — 3 December 2026, Mons; 600+ devs, 40+ talks.

sources.title: DevFest Belgium 2026
sources.claim: 6th edition; GDG Mons; AI/ML, Cloud, DevOps, Web & Mobile; 27 November 2026.

sources.title: dev.events — Mons
sources.claim: DevFest Belgium (27 Nov 2026) and DevDay (3 Dec 2026) are the upcoming developer conferences listed for Mons.

sources.title: GDG Mons
sources.claim: Monthly meetups in 2026 (7 April 'L'IA Révolution ou Bulle?'; 5 March joint IWD with GDG Brussels).

sources.title: Eventbrite — Forum Innovation & Cloud 2026
sources.claim: Thursday 26 March 2026, 13:00–19:00, Le CLICK, 30 Boulevard Initialis, Mons; Cloud & AI; AWS partner.

sources.title: Le CLICK — Mons
sources.claim: 1,500 m² innovation venue in Initialis science park; LAB + modular conference room + coworking.

sources.title: TechnocITé — Girls in ICT Day 2026
sources.claim: 23 April 2026 at Le CLICK Mons; TechnocITé + HELHa; six experts on cybersecurity careers; launch of Girls4Cyber.

sources.title: TechnocITé
sources.claim: Walloon ICT competence centre; sites in Mons and Hornu; ICT/digital training and events.

sources.title: Serre Numérique — Valenciennes
sources.claim: 17,000 m² hub for digital and creative industries — video games, animation, design, VR; regular AI/tech venue.

sources.title: Festival IA avec Nous 2026
sources.claim: 13–19 June 2026 across Hauts-de-France; Valenciennes IA Day Monday 15 June at Serre Numérique.

sources.title: Digital Wallonia — agenda
sources.claim: Canonical agenda of public digital/tech events across Wallonia (filterable by Hainaut).

sources.title: TaxiProxi — Baudour
sources.claim: Local taxi service in Baudour with online fare calculation and booking.

sources.title: Rome2Rio — Mons → Baudour
sources.claim: Fastest route by taxi: ~13 minutes, $35–$45.
